library.name: docx-preview (with JSZip)
library.description: Draws Word documents in the browser for the submission preview. Bundles JSZip 3.10.2 (MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later, https://github.com/Stuk/jszip), which includes pako (MIT).

library.name: Font Awesome Free icon "file-circle-xmark"
library.description: The broken-file icon in the missing-item box, inlined as SVG because the box is drawn inside sandboxed previews that load no fonts; also drawn into pix/missing.png, the placeholder picture put in the copy handed to the converter.
